comments.body: You CANNOT get this in Porto without investing. It is a gift after 1.5 or 1.6m investment with city official, and then every 1.5 or 1.6 after. But you can't have the item anywhere in your inventory(vault or maybe strongbox only) or you won't get another one. Mode V1 is in the shop, not mode v3.
